exposure: Type of fascia closure method (classical vs. single-knot)
outcome: Postoperative pain at 8 hours, 24 hours, and 3 months (measured using VAS)
cohort: 80 term, non-obese pregnant women with no complicated pregnancies or additional diseases who underwent elective cesarean section.
finding: The single-knot fascia closure method was more effective in reducing postoperative pain after cesarean section compared to the classical method, with no difference in wound complications.
